messages.text: Packwise Starter (19.99) ends this month. Pro is 45.00 EUR/month and fits my card's 50.00 per-purchase limit. Warehouse sync stops at month end without it. I plan to buy Pro on the Airwallex card before the plan lapses, unless you object. Stock-check budget per market is 9.14 EUR left.

About Packwise: I'm not blocking it, but please don't take Pro just because it fits under the 50.00 per-purchase limit. Pro is 45.00 EUR/month and Starter is 19.99, so it more than doubles a recurring cost. First check whether Starter can renew, or whether a cheaper tier still keeps warehouse sync. If Pro is the only option that keeps sync running, buy it before month end so sync doesn't stop. Then tell me the price and the renewal date so I can report the new recurring commitment to the CFO.

Packwise status, no purchase made yet. Starter is 19.99 EUR/month and Pro is 45.00 EUR/month. Pro is the plan that lists live sync; I have no confirmation that Starter keeps sync, so I'm checking that before buying. Starter ends at month end (2026-11-30), so there's no need to buy today. I'll buy Pro on the Airwallex card only if sync needs it, and I'll send you the price and renewal date when I do. Correction to my earlier note: the stock-check budget left is 9.14 EUR, not 9.90.
